value.note: Two barrels are set beside the long hall's end chest, so its end room holds three containers and none of them holds anything.

why: Two barrels set beside the long hall's end chest by a stage-7 batch. The end room then holds three scenery containers and nothing that pays off: a storeroom of nothing, which a player opens one by one. The notice speaks for scenery and DW1018 passes; the arrangement rule refuses the place for holding more than two. It declares no unit: the batch verbs are bound in the primary.
